title: Quantum Mechanics I
description: A first course in quantum mechanics covering wave-particle duality, wave functions, operators and observables, the Schrodinger equation, one-dimensional potentials, tunneling, the harmonic oscillator, Hilbert space, uncertainty, angular momentum, the hydrogen atom, spin, identical particles, and introductory approximation methods.
